papers.title_en: Multi-Task Partially Supervised Learning for Super-Resolution and Semantic Segmentation on Earth Observation data
papers.authors: Hoàng-Ân Lê, Minh-Tan Pham, Solange Lemai-Chenevier, Daniel Greslou
papers.evidence: 地球观测数据的多任务超分与语义分割
papers.tldr: 地球观测中，超分辨率与语义分割可互相促进，但联合训练通常需同时具备两类标注，成本高且不现实。本文研究多任务部分监督范式，每个样本仅含单任务标注，并比较串行与共享两种多任务结构。作者提出混合结构与重投影损失，以利用共享表示并约束分割训练时的超分图像质量。实验相比当前最优串行方案取得更优结果，代码将开源。
papers.abstract_en: Super-resolution and semantic segmentation are known to benefit one another, especially in the Earth observation context. However, learning both tasks in a joint model often requires both task annotations, which is impractical and expensive. In this paper, we study the multi-task partially supervised learning paradigm for both tasks, where each example is assumed to have only a single-task annotation. To that end, we examine two multi-task architectural variations, the sequential and shared variants, and then propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to benefit from the shared representation and enforce image quality of super-resolution when training with semantic segmentation. Experiments show favorable results compared to the SOTA sequential variant. Source code will be published at https://github.com/lhoangan/munera.

papers.title_en: SAREO-FM: Decoupled Semantic Supervision for SAR-EO Foundation Models
papers.evidence: SAR与光学遥感基础模型及语义监督
papers.tldr: SAR与EO遥感互补，但现有基础模型常让同一 token 流同时承担重建与语义任务，易造成目标冲突。SAREO-FM 将模态 token 用于掩码重建以保留各传感器观测方式，另设可学习语义查询，在预训练视觉基础模型引导下捕捉场景内容。查询与 SAR/EO token 在共享编码器中交互，获得模态语义上下文，同时重建监督仍作用于模态 token 输出。基于百万级 SAR-1M 预训练后，模型在 SAR/EO 单模态迁移上表现强劲，并在联合观测任务中取得显著增益。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) imagery provide complementary observations: SAR enables day-and-night, weather-resilient sensing, whereas EO provides rich appearance and fine-grained semantic cues. We introduce SAREO-FM, which avoids forcing a single token stream to serve two distinct roles: modality tokens preserve how each sensor observes the scene through masked reconstruction, while learnable semantic queries capture what the scene contains under guidance from a pretrained vision foundation model (VFM). By jointly encoding these queries with SAR and EO tokens, the queries acquire modality-grounded semantic context, while the modality-token outputs remain the explicit targets of masked reconstruction. This design assigns semantic and reconstruction supervision to separate token streams while preserving their interaction within the shared encoder. Pretrained on the million-scale SAR-1M corpus, SAREO-FM achieves strong unimodal transfer for both SAR-only and EO-only inputs, while delivering substantial gains from joint SAR--EO observations on tasks that benefit from complementary sensing.

papers.title_en: Seek-and-View Reasoning for Multi-View Spatial Understanding
papers.authors: Qixiang Chen, Cheng Zhang, Fucai Ke, Chi-Wing Fu, Jianfei Cai, Jingwen Ye
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型结合三维基础模型的多视角空间推理
papers.tldr: 现有多视角空间推理多依赖稀疏输入视图，VLM受限于固定视角，导致跨视图对齐脆弱且几何到语言存在瓶颈。为此，论文提出Seek-and-View推理范式，通过定位问题相关视角寻找隐式跨视图空间证据。作者实现免训练、模型无关框架Vantage，将VLM与3D基础模型结合，先进行视角锚定推理与视图规划，再做几何锚定证据增强。在六个VLM和五个基准上无需微调即取得一致提升，降低对语言式跨视图对齐的依赖，改善多视角空间理解。
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches to multi-view spatial reasoning operate largely on sparse input views. Vision-language models (VLMs) are thus restricted to understand a scene and infer spatial relations within these fixed views, leading to fragile cross-view alignment and geometry-to-language bottleneck. To address these issues, we formulate a novel Seek-and-View reasoning approach to find implicit cross-view spatial evidence by locating a question-relevant view to support the spatial reasoning. To realize this approach, we propose Vantage, a training-free model-agnostic reasoning framework that pairs a VLM with a 3D foundation model: a viewpoint-grounded reasoning stage for question analysis and view planning, followed by a geometry-grounded evidence augmentation stage to effectively synthesize and incorporate visual evidence into the final reasoning. Comprehensive experiments on six VLMs demonstrate consistent improvements on five benchmarks without fine-tuning. Overall, by revealing spatial evidence through view-grounded reasoning, Vantage can largely reduce reliance on language-based cross-view alignment and improve multi-view spatial understanding. Our code is available at https://github.com/q1xiangchen/Vantage.
